kaa.solution_md:
Qaǵıydalar: $Ox$ qa qatnasla $(x;y)\to(x;-y)$; $Oy$ qa qatnasla $(x;y)\to(-x;y)$; koordinatalar basına qatnasla $(x;y)\to(-x;-y)$; $y=x$ ke qatnasla $(x;y)\to(y;x)$; saat tilińe qarsı $90^{\circ}$ qa burıwda $(x;y)\to(-y;x)$; saat tili boyınsha $(x;y)\to(y;-x)$.

1-bánd: $(4;-2)$; 2-bánd: $(-2;-4)$; 3-bánd: $(2;4)$.

en.solution_md:
Rules: reflection in $Ox$ gives $(x;y)\to(x;-y)$; in $Oy$ gives $(x;y)\to(-x;y)$; in the origin gives $(x;y)\to(-x;-y)$; in $y=x$ gives $(x;y)\to(y;x)$; a $90^{\circ}$ counterclockwise rotation gives $(x;y)\to(-y;x)$; a clockwise one gives $(x;y)\to(y;-x)$.

Item 1: $(-3;-1)$; item 2: $(-1;3)$; item 3: $(1;3)$.
